newsitem.title: BULGARIA: KPMG to advise Bulgaria on three major sell-offs.
newsitem.headline: KPMG to advise Bulgaria on three major sell-offs.

text.p: Bulgaria's Privatisation Agency (PA) said on Wednesday it has selected KPMG Barents Group as investment consultant for the sale of two big state chemical plants on pharmaceuticals producer.
"The agency signed an investment consultancy contract with KPMG Barents Group for the sale of Agrobiochim, Antibiotic and Verila", the Privatisation Agency said in a statement.

The Verila bio-products and polymers manufacturer, the Agrobiochim bio-products and fertiliser producer and the Antibiotic drugs factory are the first on a list of 30 companies slated for quick privatisation by the reformist government.
The success fee contract is sealed under a technical assistance agreement with the U.S. Agency for Investment Development.
Under the contract KPMG is to prepare the sale of the three companies in five months.

The government relies on privatisation proceeds to fund most of the gaps in this year's austerity budget after introducing on Tuesday a restrictive fixed exchange rate regime which bans central bank lending to the government.
Under an agreement with the International Monetary Fund, Bulgaria has pledged to privatise all commercial enterprises and half its utilities within two years.
